versions.changelog:
- Initial release of odata-service skill supporting full OData v4.0/v4.01 protocol.
- Enables model discovery, queries, entity CRUD operations, relationship management, functions, actions, and batch/asynchronous requests.
- Requires explicit user authorization for any state-changing request.
- Includes detailed instructions for endpoint/profile resolution and safe request handling.
- Enforces strict protocol and security rules, including metadata-driven logic, concurrency controls, and careful mutation execution.
